# MASTER BUILD PROMPT — "RODEO ERP": PIXEL-EXACT, FEATURE-COMPLETE CLONE OF ODOO 19 (saas~19.4 Enterprise) ON AWS AMPLIFY GEN 2 + NEXT.JS APP ROUTER

> **Source of truth.** Every line of this document was extracted programmatically and visually from a live Odoo 19.4 Enterprise instance (database `masta`, apps: Discuss, Calendar, Appointments, To-do, Knowledge, Sales, Dashboards, Rental, Accounting, Documents, Project, Planning, Helpdesk, Surveys, Purchase, Sign, Employees, Attendances, Fleet, Approvals, Apps, Settings). It contains the complete menu tree (331 menu items), 277 screens/actions, 664 view definitions (list/kanban/form/search/calendar/pivot/graph/gantt/activity/map/cohort/hierarchy/grid), ~4,000 fields with English + Arabic labels, every button with its visibility condition, every filter and group-by, every settings option, the default seed data, the exact CSS design tokens, and the behaviour of the custom (non-generic) screens.
>
> **How to read it.** Part A = architecture & engine you must build. Part B = the design system (exact colors, sizes, fonts, components). Part C = the global shell and every generic behaviour + the custom screens. Part D = cross-app business logic (state machines, integrations). Part E = the 22 applications, screen by screen, view by view, field by field (generated from the live instance). Part F = the Settings pages. Part G = shared dialogs. Part H = the data-model reference (every field). Part I = seed data. Part J = QA checklist and build order.
>
> **Non-negotiable rules.**
> 1. Nothing in Part E–I is optional. Every menu, screen, view, column, field, button, filter, group-by, tab, smart button, wizard, setting, and seed record listed must exist and work. If a button says `→ calls action_confirm`, implement the business method with the semantics described in Part D.
> 2. The UI must be visually indistinguishable from Odoo 19 at 1280×609 and at 1920×1080: same layout, spacing, colors, typography, icons, hover states, badges, empty states, dialogs, toasts, keyboard shortcuts. Use Part B tokens literally.
> 3. The app is bilingual: English (LTR, default for new users = `en_US`) and Arabic (RTL, `ar_001`). Every string in the UI has EN and AR variants — the specs are written as `English / العربية`. The layout mirrors completely in RTL (see B-9). Dates in Arabic use Arabic-Indic digits; amounts always use Latin digits with `,` thousands and `.` decimals and the currency label after the number (`0.00 QR`).
> 4. Everything is dynamic: one metadata-driven engine renders all models/views; business rules live in server-side functions; all data is persisted; nothing is mocked or hard-coded; all apps share the same partners, products, users, companies, currencies, attachments, messages, activities and followers.
> 5. Reliability: every mutation is transactional; sequences never produce duplicates; state transitions are validated server-side; access rights are enforced server-side; every list is paginated; every long operation shows progress; every error shows an Odoo-style dialog (title "Validation Error" / "Access Error" / "User Error" + message).
> 6. Do not skip, summarise or "simplify" a screen because it is large. Where this document says "same as V0xx", reuse that view definition.

## TABLE OF CONTENTS

- PART A — Architecture: the metadata engine (stack, registry, ORM, client engine, directory layout, jobs, tests)
- PART B — Design system (exact colors, typography, spacing, components, icons, RTL, login page)
- PART C — Global shell, generic behaviours, custom screens (Discuss, Knowledge, Dashboards, Documents, Sign, Attendances/Kiosk, Accounting dashboard & financial reports, Helpdesk/Approvals/Project/Planning/Surveys/Appointments/Fleet/Employees/Apps specifics) + C-13 financial report definitions
- PART D — Cross-app business logic (numbering, state machines, buttons, computed fields, integrations, reports)
- PART E — THE 22 APPLICATIONS, screen by screen (generated from the live instance): navigation trees, screens S001…S277, views V001…V664 with every column/field/button/tab/filter/group-by
- PART F — Settings pages (every setting of every app) + screens reached from Settings
- PART G — Shared dialogs (Schedule Activity, Send message composer, followers, export, My Preferences, calendar quick create) + other deep-linked screens
- PART H — Data model reference (every field of every model with EN/AR labels, types, relations, selections) + printable reports
- PART I — Default / seed data
- PART J — Build order, quality gates, acceptance checklist

## PART A — ARCHITECTURE: BUILD AN "ODOO-CLASS" METADATA ENGINE, NOT 276 HAND-MADE PAGES

Odoo's UI is generated from metadata: **models → fields**, **views (XML archs) → generic renderers**, **actions → the thing a menu opens**, **menus → navbar**. Reproducing 276 screens by hand-coding React pages would be impossible to keep consistent. You must therefore build the same engine and then feed it the metadata in Parts E–H. This is the only way to satisfy "every option, dynamic, consistent, reliable".

### A-1. Stack (mandatory)

| Layer | Choice | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Framework | **Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript strict, React 19** | `app/` directory; server components for shells, client components for the engine views; route `app/[locale]/odoo/[...path]` reproduces Odoo URLs (`/odoo`, `/odoo/sales`, `/odoo/sales/12`, `/odoo/action-449`, `/odoo/orders?view_type=kanban`, `/odoo/discuss`, `/odoo/knowledge/32`, `/odoo/settings#sale_management`, `/odoo/accounting`, `/odoo/profit-and-loss` …). Locale prefix is optional: default locale is stored per user; URLs without prefix use the user's language. |
| Backend | **AWS Amplify Gen 2** (`amplify/backend.ts`) | `defineAuth` (Cognito user pool: email login + password, passkey/WebAuthn optional, "Reset Password", "Don't have an account?" link disabled by default = invitation-only like Odoo), `defineData` (AppSync GraphQL), `defineStorage` (S3 for attachments, avatars, PDFs, document files, spreadsheet files, sign PDFs), `defineFunction` (Lambda business logic), custom CDK resources (Aurora, EventBridge Scheduler, SES, OpenSearch optional). |
| Database | **Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2** connected to Amplify Data as a SQL data source (`a.sql.schema` generated with `npx ampx generate schema-from-database`) **plus** hand-written Lambda resolvers (Node 20, `pg`/Drizzle) for the generic ORM operations. | Reason: Odoo semantics (domains, `read_group`, pivot, sorting on related fields, sequences, transactions, reports) need SQL. DynamoDB-only is NOT acceptable for this clone. Keep one schema; migrations with Drizzle Kit in `amplify/db/migrations`. |
| API | AppSync GraphQL with **custom mutations/queries backed by Lambda** that implement the Odoo RPC surface: `searchRead`, `readGroup`, `webRead`, `create`, `write`, `unlink`, `onchange`, `callButton` (execute a model method such as `action_confirm`), `loadAction`, `loadMenus`, `getViews`, `nameSearch`, `defaultGet`, `copy`, `toggleActive`, `exportData`, `importData`, `getReportPdf`, `mailMessagePost`, `activitySchedule`… (see A-4). | All auth-guarded (Cognito). Subscriptions: `onMessage(channelId)`, `onNotification(userId)`, `onRecordChanged(model,id)` for chatter/discuss/systray counters. |
| Files | S3 via Amplify Storage with per-record folders `attachments/{model}/{id}/{uuid}`; presigned URLs; image thumbnails (Lambda + sharp) for avatars 128/256/512/1024/1920 like Odoo. |
| Email | SES (outgoing mail server settings page maps to SES config), inbound aliases via SES receipt rules → Lambda (helpdesk/project aliases). |
| Scheduling | EventBridge Scheduler → Lambda cron jobs (see A-7). |
| PDF | Lambda (puppeteer-core + @sparticuz/chromium) rendering HTML report templates (QWeb-like React-to-HTML) with the company document layout (Part E › Settings › "Configure your document layout"). |
| Realtime | AppSync subscriptions (Discuss messages, typing, presence, notifications, kanban/gantt live updates). Presence: heartbeat mutation every 30 s; status online/away/offline. |
| Search | Postgres `ILIKE`/`unaccent`/`pg_trgm` for `name_search`; optional OpenSearch for Knowledge/Documents full text. |
| i18n | `next-intl`; message catalogs `messages/en.json`, `messages/ar.json` generated from this document (every `EN / AR` pair becomes an entry keyed by the English text, exactly like Odoo's PO files). Field labels, selection labels, menu names, view strings, help texts, filter names are all translatable and stored in the metadata (`{ en, ar }`). |
| Styling | CSS Modules/SCSS + CSS variables from Part B; **Bootstrap 5.3 grid & utilities** (Odoo 19 is built on Bootstrap 5 — reuse the same utility class names: `d-flex`, `gap-2`, `text-muted`, `badge rounded-pill text-bg-info`, `btn btn-primary`, `alert alert-warning`…). Use `rtlcss` in the build to generate the mirrored stylesheet for `[dir=rtl]`. |
| Icons | **Font Awesome 4.7** (`fa fa-*` — Odoo still uses FA4 names such as `fa-tasks`, `fa-clock-o`, `fa-comments`, `fa-pencil-square-o`, `fa-money`, `fa-th`, `fa-credit-card`, `fa-check`, `fa-envelope`, `fa-refresh`, `fa-exclamation-triangle`, `fa-lg`, `fa-fw`) + Odoo UI icon font (`oi oi-*`: `oi-studio`, `oi-view-list`, `oi-view-kanban`, `oi-arrow-right`, `oi-chevron-down`, `oi-settings-adjust`, `oi-panel-right`…). Ship both fonts locally. |
| Testing | Playwright e2e (one spec per screen listed in Part E), Vitest unit tests for the ORM/domain evaluator/expression evaluator/number formatting, seed-data snapshot tests. |

### A-2. The metadata registry (`packages/engine/registry/`)

Implement TypeScript types that mirror Odoo exactly, then load Parts E–H into them (recommended: transcribe Parts E–H into JSON files `registry/models/*.json`, `registry/views/*.json`, `registry/actions.json`, `registry/menus.json`, `registry/seed/*.json`; a companion machine-readable export `odoo_spec.json` with the same content is supplied next to this prompt — use it to generate the JSON files instead of retyping).

```ts
type FieldType = 'char'|'text'|'html'|'integer'|'float'|'monetary'|'boolean'|'date'|'datetime'|'selection'|'many2one'|'one2many'|'many2many'|'binary'|'image'|'reference'|'many2one_reference'|'json'|'properties'|'properties_definition';
interface FieldDef { name: string; type: FieldType; label: I18n; help?: I18n; required?: boolean|Expr; readonly?: boolean|Expr; relation?: string; inverse?: string /* o2m */; selection?: {value:string; label:I18n}[]; default?: any|((ctx)=>any); compute?: string /* function name */; store?: boolean; depends?: string[]; related?: string; currencyField?: string; digits?: [number,number]; tracking?: boolean; index?: boolean; translate?: boolean; companyDependent?: boolean; domain?: Domain|Expr; groups?: string[]; copy?: boolean; ondelete?: 'cascade'|'set null'|'restrict'; sanitize?: boolean; }
interface ModelDef { name: string /* 'sale.order' */; description: I18n; table: string; recName: string /* 'name' */; order: string /* 'date_order desc, id desc' */; fields: Record<string, FieldDef>; inherits?: string[] /* mixins: mail.thread, mail.activity.mixin, utm.mixin, rating.mixin, portal.mixin, avatar.mixin, image.mixin, analytic.mixin, sequence.mixin */; delegates?: Record<string,string> /* _inherits */; sqlConstraints?: {name:string; sql:string; message:I18n}[]; access: AccessRule[]; recordRules: RecordRule[]; methods: Record<string, MethodDef>; transient?: boolean; }
interface ActionDef { id: number|string; xmlId: string; type: 'act_window'|'client'|'server'|'report'|'url'; name: I18n; model?: string; viewMode?: string[] /* order of the view switcher */; views?: [number|false, ViewType][]; domain?: Domain; context?: Record<string,any>; target?: 'current'|'new'|'fullscreen'|'main'; help?: I18nHtml; searchViewId?: number; limit?: number; path?: string /* URL slug */; tag?: string /* client action name */; params?: any; url?: string; reportName?: string; groups?: string[]; bindingModel?: string; bindingType?: 'action'|'report'; }
interface MenuDef { id: number; xmlId: string; name: I18n; parentId?: number; sequence: number; actionId?: ActionDef['id']; groups?: string[]; webIcon?: string /* app icon */; children: MenuDef[]; }
type ViewType = 'list'|'form'|'kanban'|'search'|'calendar'|'pivot'|'graph'|'gantt'|'activity'|'map'|'cohort'|'grid'|'hierarchy';
interface ViewDef { id: number; model: string; type: ViewType; arch: ViewNode /* the parsed tree exactly as in Part E */; inheritId?: number; priority?: number; }
```

**Expressions.** Odoo's `invisible`, `readonly`, `required`, `column_invisible`, `decoration-*`, `domain` and `context` attributes are Python-like expressions evaluated against the current record (`state != 'draft'`, `not partner_id`, `parent.state == 'sale'`, `context.get('hide_pdf_quote_builder')`, `context_today()`, `today`, `uid`, `allowed_company_ids`, `[('company_id','in',allowed_company_ids)]`, `product_uom_qty > 0 and not display_type`, `state in ['draft','sent']`, `commitment_date and (expected_date < commitment_date or ...)`, `'%Y-%m-%d'` strftime…). Write one **expression evaluator** (`packages/engine/expr/`) that parses this Python subset (literals, lists/tuples/dicts, `and/or/not`, comparisons incl. `in`/`not in`, arithmetic, attribute access `parent.x`, `context.get()`, `.strftime()`, `datetime`/`relativedelta` helpers, `bool()`, `len()`, `any()`, string methods) and evaluates it both **client-side** (view conditions) and **server-side** (domains, defaults, record rules). Domains are the Odoo polish-notation lists `['|', ('a','=',1), ('b','!=',False)]` with operators `= != > >= < <= like ilike not like not ilike =like =ilike in not in child_of parent_of any not any`; implement `domainToSql()` and `domainMatch(record)`.

### A-3. The ORM (server, `amplify/functions/orm/`)

Implement an `Environment` per request (`uid`, `context`, `companyIds`, `lang`, `tz`) and the following operations for every model, with **exactly** Odoo's semantics:

- `create(vals[])`, `write(ids, vals)`, `unlink(ids)`, `copy(id, defaults)` — apply defaults (`default_get`: field defaults, `default_<field>` context keys, company/currency/user defaults), compute stored computed fields (dependency graph, recompute on `depends`), run `onchange` chains, validate constraints (`required`, sql constraints, `_check_*` python constraints listed per model in Part D), write `create_date/create_uid/write_date/write_uid`, post tracking messages for `tracking=true` fields (chatter "Changed X: old → new"), fire automations/subscriptions.
- `search_read(domain, fields, offset, limit, order, context)` with `active_test` (hide `active=false` unless `active_test: False`), record rules, company filtering (`allowed_company_ids`), name display of many2one as `[id, display_name]`, one2many/many2many as id arrays, monetary formatting metadata.
- `read_group(domain, fields, groupby, lazy, orderby)` for list group-by headers, kanban columns, pivot & graph (support `date:month`, `date:week`, `date:quarter`, `date:year`, `date:day` intervals, aggregates `sum/avg/min/max/count/count_distinct/bool_and`, `__count`, `__domain`, `__fold`).
- `name_search(name, domain, operator, limit)` (used by every many2one dropdown — first 8 results, "Search More…", "Create "xxx"", "Create and edit…").
- `onchange(values, fieldNames, fieldOnchange)` — return updated values + warnings (`{warning: {title, message}}` shows a warning dialog, e.g. partner "Sale warning") + domain changes.
- `web_read` / `web_save` with **specification** (nested fields for x2many like Odoo 17+): forms load the record and its lines in one call.
- `call_button(model, ids, method, context)` → executes business methods (`action_confirm`, `action_post`, `button_cancel`…) returning either nothing (reload), an action to open (wizard `target: new`), a URL, a notification `{type:'ir.actions.client', tag:'display_notification', params:{title, message, type:'success'|'warning'|'danger', sticky}}`, or `{type:'ir.actions.act_window_close'}`.
- `toggle_active` (archive/unarchive), `action_archive`, `action_unarchive`, `export_data(fields)` (XLSX/CSV), `load(import)`, `get_formview_action`, `message_post`, `message_subscribe`, `activity_schedule`, `activity_feedback`, `activity_unlink`, `get_views(views)`, `load_action`, `load_menus`, `fields_get`.
- **Sequences** (`ir.sequence`): `next_by_code(code)` transactional (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`), prefix with `%(year)s`, `%(month)s`, date-range sequences (per year), padding — used for `S00001` quotations, `INV/2026/00001` invoices, `RINV/…` credit notes, `BILL/…`, `PAY/…`, `P00001` purchases, `HT00001` helpdesk?, `AR000001` approvals, `PBNK1/…` bank, `MISC/…`, etc. (see Part I `ir.sequence`).
- **Mixins** implemented once and reused: `mail.thread` (messages, followers, tracking, notifications), `mail.activity.mixin` (activities, `activity_state` planned/today/overdue, `activity_summary`, `my_activity_date_deadline`), `rating.mixin`, `utm.mixin`, `portal.mixin` (access token & share URL), `image.mixin` (image_1920 → 1024/512/256/128 variants), `avatar.mixin` (generated SVG avatar with initial letter on colored background — exactly like Odoo: square, 1 letter, hue derived from name), `analytic.mixin`, `sequence.mixin`, `html.field.history.mixin`, `properties` (custom fields per parent record, used by Project tasks / Knowledge / Helpdesk / Fleet), `resource.mixin`.
- **Access control**: groups (`res.groups`) exactly as Part I lists them; per-model CRUD access rules; record rules (e.g. "Personal Quotations: user_id = uid", "Own documents", multi-company rule `company_id in allowed_company_ids`); UI hides elements with `groups="..."`; server throws `AccessError`. Roles UI = user form "Access Rights" tab (Part E › Settings › Users).
- **Multi-company**: `res.company` records, company switcher in systray when >1 company, `company_id` on every business record, company-dependent fields (properties), per-company sequences/journals/currencies.
- **Currencies & amounts**: `res.currency` with `rounding`, `decimal_places`, `symbol`, `position`; monetary fields render with the currency of `currency_field`; multi-currency conversion with rates; `float_round`, `float_compare` semantics.
- **Dates**: store UTC; render in user tz (`Asia/Riyadh`); date formats per language (`%m/%d/%Y` en, `%d/%m/%Y` ar, 12-hour clock `%I:%M:%S %p`); relative dates in chatter ("Today", "Yesterday", "2 days ago", "Sep 11").

### A-4. The client engine (`packages/engine/web/`)

Re-implement Odoo's web client components (OWL → React). Each item below is used by dozens of screens; implement once, parametrised by the view arch:

1. **WebClient shell**: navbar, home menu, action manager (breadcrumbs stack, `target=new` dialogs stack, `target=fullscreen`), URL router (`/odoo/<path>` and `?view_type=`, `&id=`, `#hash` for settings anchors), loading indicator (thin progress bar under navbar), "sticky" notifications (toasts bottom-right, 4 s, types success/warning/danger/info), error dialogs (traceback expander in debug mode), debug mode (`?debug=1` adds the bug icon menu: View Fields, View Metadata, Edit View, Set Defaults, Manage Filters, Technical translation, Run JS tests…), session expired dialog, offline banner.
2. **Control panel** (`.o_control_panel`): left: primary button (New / Upload PDF / New Request / Save+Discard on settings) + breadcrumb (parents as links, current as text, gear menu next to the title with: Export, Archive/Unarchive, Duplicate, Delete, Print submenu, Actions submenu, Spreadsheet insert, "Knowledge: Use as description/Send as message" when available), form status indicator (cloud icon = saved / spinning = saving / ✕ = discard changes / "New" label); center: **search view** (facets chips; typing shows dropdown of "Search Field for: text" rows from `<search><field>` in order; ↓/↑/Enter; Backspace removes last facet; dropdown panel with Filters / Group By / Favorites in 3 columns exactly as B-7/C-3; date filter submenus; custom filter dialog (domain editor tree: field picker, operator, value, "Add rule", "Add group", "Match all/any", "Code editor" in debug); custom group by select; favorites with "Default filter" + "Shared" checkboxes, save/edit/delete; **search panel** sidebar (folders/tags) when `<searchpanel>` present); right: pager `1-80 / 250` with `‹ ›` (click on numbers edits the range, Enter applies), view switcher buttons (icons per type, active teal), and in kanban/list/gantt the "Toggle search panel" button when applicable.
3. **List view** (`.o_list_view`): sticky header, checkbox column (select all/page, "Select all N records" banner), sortable headers (↑↓ icon), resizable columns (drag), optional-columns dropdown (⚙ at the right end of the header: checkboxes per `optional="show|hide"` column, saved per user in localStorage), inline editing (`editable="top|bottom"`: clicking a row edits in place, ✓/✕, Enter to next line, "Add a line" row; `multi_edit`: editing a cell with several rows selected asks "Update N records?"), row decorations (`decoration-danger` red text, `-warning` orange, `-success` green, `-info` blue, `-muted` grey, `-bf` bold, `-it` italic), grouped rows (collapsible group headers with counts and aggregates, "Load more (N remaining)", drag to reorder groups when `handle`), footer aggregates (`sum`/`avg` labels), column widgets (`badge`, `many2one_avatar_user`, `many2many_tags`, `monetary`, `handle` (drag icon), `boolean_toggle`, `priority` stars, `list_activity` (activity icon + summary), `float_time`, `progressbar`, `remaining_days`, `image`, `char_emojis`, `label_selection`, `state_selection` (colored dot dropdown), `x2many_buttons`, `url`, `email`, `phone`, `percentage`, `color_picker`, `daterange`, `timesheet_uom`…), row buttons (`<button icon>`), `open_form_view` icon, header buttons (`Send Mail`, `Create Invoices`…), context menu on selection (Export, Archive, Unarchive, Duplicate, Delete + model-specific actions and reports listed under each view's "⚙ action menu (gear) extras"), keyboard navigation (arrows, Enter opens), "sample data" mode: when a view has `sample="1"` and no records → render 10 fake rows at `opacity:.06` behind the empty-state help block (see B-8).

### A-5. Directory layout (recommended)

```
amplify/
  backend.ts                    # wires auth, data, storage, functions, custom CDK (Aurora, SES, EventBridge, OpenSearch)
  auth/resource.ts              # Cognito: email+password, groups synced from res.groups, custom attributes: lang, tz, odoo_user_id
  data/resource.ts              # AppSync schema: generic RPC queries/mutations + subscriptions + SQL-generated models (read-only typed access)
  storage/resource.ts           # S3 buckets: attachments, images, sign, documents, spreadsheets, reports
  functions/rpc/                # the ORM + all business methods (one folder per app: sale/, account/, purchase/, project/, ...)
  functions/cron/               # scheduled jobs (see A-7)
  functions/mail/               # SES send/receive, mail.mail queue, notifications digest
  functions/report/             # PDF rendering
  db/schema/*.ts                # Drizzle schema generated from registry/models (one table per model, m2m relation tables)
  db/migrations/
  db/seed/                      # Part I seed data loaders
packages/engine/                # registry types, expression evaluator, domain compiler, formatting, i18n
apps/web/                       # Next.js app: app/[locale]/odoo/... routes, components/views/*, components/fields/*, components/chatter, apps/* custom screens
registry/                       # JSON metadata transcribed from Parts E–I (menus, actions, views, models, groups, seed)
messages/{en,ar}.json           # i18n catalogs
```

### A-6. Deployment & environments

- `npx ampx sandbox` for dev; branch deployments via Amplify Hosting (main → prod). Aurora in private subnets, Lambdas in VPC with RDS Proxy. Secrets via Amplify secrets (`SES_FROM`, `DB_URL`).
- Environment config UI lives inside the app (Settings › General Settings), NOT in env vars: company data, document layout, languages, outgoing mail servers (SES config exposed as `ir.mail_server` records), digest emails, developer tools.
- Seed on first deploy: Part I data + demo-free empty state (the instance we captured is empty of business documents, showing onboarding/sample-data states — reproduce those exact empty states).

### A-7. Scheduled jobs (EventBridge → Lambda), all configurable from Settings › Technical (debug) › Scheduled Actions

| Job | Frequency | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Mail: send queued emails (`mail.mail`) | every 1 min | SES send, retries, bounce handling |
| Mail: fetch incoming (aliases) | on SES receipt | create tickets/tasks/leads from emails, reply threads to chatter |
| Activities: daily reminder digest | daily 08:00 | notify assigned users of today's/overdue activities |
| Digest emails (`digest.digest`) | weekly/daily/monthly | KPI email per Settings |
| Calendar: reminders (`calendar.alarm`) | every 1 min | email/notification/SMS reminders before events |
| Calendar: Google sync | every 1 min if connected | |
| Helpdesk: SLA status recompute | every 10 min | `helpdesk.sla.status` deadlines, failed flags |
| Helpdesk: auto-close inactive tickets | daily | per team setting |
| Project: recurring tasks generation | daily | `project.task.recurrence` |
| Planning: auto-send/publish, open-shift reminders | daily | |
| Attendance: auto check-out / absence detection | hourly | per settings (Automatic Check-Out after N hours; Absence management) |
| Attendance: overtime recompute | daily | `hr.attendance.overtime` |
| Accounting: post entries automatically (`auto_post`), asset depreciation entries, deferred revenues/expenses, loan entries, tax return deadlines, bank sync, currency rates update (`res.currency.rate` provider), invoice payment reminders/follow-ups, EDI queue | daily / hourly | |
| Sales: quotation expiration (`validity_date` → expired flag), online payment/sign status polling | daily | |
| Rental: late pickup/return statuses (`is_late`) | hourly | |
| Sign: expiration, reminders (`reminder` days) | daily | |
| Fleet: contract expiry warnings (`fleet.vehicle.log.contract` "expired"/"expiring soon") | daily | |
| Approvals: nothing scheduled | — | |
| Surveys: certification/reminder emails | daily | |
| Discuss: garbage-collect presence, notify offline users by email of unread messages (after 30 min) | every 5 min | |
| Documents: request reminders, deletion delay (Trash 30 days) | daily | |
| Knowledge: trash purge (after 30 days) | daily | |
| Gamification: challenge goal updates | daily | |
| Base: garbage-collect sessions/attachments, `ir.autovacuum` | daily | |

### A-8. Testing & acceptance harness

For every screen `Sxxx` in Part E create `e2e/screens/Sxxx.spec.ts` that: opens the menu path, asserts the breadcrumb title (EN and AR), the view switcher order, the default facets, the presence of every column/field/button/tab listed, opens each dialog/wizard and asserts its fields and footer buttons, and takes a screenshot compared against the reference (tolerance 0.1%). Unit-test the expression evaluator against every `invisible`/`readonly`/`required`/`domain` string found in Part E (they must all parse).

### B-2. Typography

- Font stack (body): `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Ubuntu, "Noto Sans", Arial, "Odoo Unicode Support Noto", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"`. Headings (h1–h3, empty-state titles): `"SF Pro Display", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, …`. Ship Noto Sans + Noto Sans Arabic as fallback so Arabic renders identically on all OSes.
- Base: `14px / 21px` (line-height 1.5), weight 400, color `#111827`.
- Sizes: navbar app name `16.8px/26px` (1.2rem); breadcrumb current `16.8px/25.2px`; breadcrumb parent link `13px/16.25px` weight 500; form record title h1 `33.6px/40.32px` weight 500 (2.4rem); empty-state title h2 `21px/25.2px` weight 500; empty-state paragraph `16.1px/24.15px`; labels `14px` weight 500; buttons `14px` weight 500; badges `11.9px` weight 500 (list) / `9.8px` (systray counter); kanban card title `17.5px` (`fs-5`) bold; small text `12.25px` (`.small`, 0.875em); dashboard KPI number `32px` light; section titles on dashboards `20px` bold teal-blue `#1F5F8B`-like.
- Letter-spacing normal; no uppercase transforms except dashboard sidebar section names (uppercase bold 12px).

### B-3. Spacing, radius, shadows

- Base unit 4px. Control panel padding `8px 16px 16px`, gap `16px`; sheet padding `24px`; kanban renderer padding `8px`; card padding `8px`, card margin `4px 8px`; list cell padding `8px 4.8px 8px 16px` (first cell 16px left); embedded list cell `8px 4.8px 8px 24px`; settings block padding `16px 24px`.
- Border radius: buttons/inputs/cards/sheet `4px`; app tiles `6px`; dropdown panels/dialog `8px`; badges pill `800px`; checkbox `3.5px`; avatar 26px navbar `4px`; kanban avatar circle 50%.
- Borders `0.6667px` (renders as 1px hairline) `#D8DADD`.
- Shadows: app icon `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.2), 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.02), 0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.02), 0 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.02), 0 8px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.02), 0 16px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.02)`; dropdown/dialog `0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12)`; kanban card hover `0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08)`; sticky headers `0 1px 0 #D8DADD`.
- Heights: navbar `46px` (padding 10px 0); control panel `61px`; buttons `36px` (padding 7px 14px); inputs in forms `24px` line with bottom border only; search bar `36px`; list header `40px`, rows `40.67px`, footer `37px`; stage chips `33px`; notebook tabs `38px`; chatter topbar `52px`; app tile `115×141.67px`, icon `70×70px` (padding 10px); Discuss sidebar `300px`; Documents/Knowledge sidebar `300px`; Dashboards sidebar `200px`; settings sidebar `150px`; search box `376px`.

### B-4. Components (exact)

- **Buttons**: `.btn` 14px/500, radius 4px, padding 7px 14px, border 1px. Primary: bg/border `#714B67`, text white; hover darker. Secondary: bg/border `#E7E9ED`, text `#111827`; hover `#D8DADD`. Outline-primary (form "New" in control panel): transparent bg, border+text `#714B67`. Link buttons: text `#017E84`, no border. Icon-only buttons 36×36. Split buttons (New ▾ in Documents). Disabled: opacity .65.
- **Inputs (form)**: no box; bottom border 1px `#E7E9ED` at rest, `#000` on focus (many2one shows `#E7E9ED` at rest); placeholder muted; many2one caret `▾` at the right; date fields with calendar icon on the left; monetary with currency label after number; textarea auto-grow. Inputs inside dialogs/settings/kiosk: full bordered boxes radius 4px `#D8DADD`.
- **Checkbox**: 14×14, border `#D8DADD`, radius 3.5px, checked bg `#714B67`; toggle (`boolean_toggle`): 30×16 pill, on = `#714B67`.
- **Badges**: `badge rounded-pill text-bg-{info|success|warning|danger|secondary|light}`; `label_selection` mapping per view (e.g. sale state draft→info, sale→success, cancel→default).

Odoo 19 renders large "bottom-sheet-like" panels for the user menu / channel actions / search date picker: centered panel 500px wide, radius 12px, drag handle bar at top (a 76×4px grey pill), items 16px tall rows.
- **Dialog (modal)**: header title 19.6px + ✕; body; footer buttons left-aligned (primary first); sizes sm 500 / md 800 / lg 1000 / xl 1140; backdrop `rgba(0,0,0,.5)`; nested dialogs stack with offset.
- **Toast notifications**: bottom-right? (Odoo 17+: top-right under navbar), 4 s, colored left border by type, close ✕, "sticky" stays.
- **Tables (list)**: header bg `#F9FAFB`, th weight 500 black, border-bottom `#D8DADD`; rows white with hairline `rgba(0,0,0,.02)`; hover row `#F3F4F6`; selected row `#E6F2F3`; group header rows bold with counts and `▸/▾`; footer aggregates weight 500.
- **Kanban card**: white, border `#D8DADD`, radius 4px (grouped) / 0 (some ungrouped older templates), padding 8px, hover shadow; left color stripe 3px when colored; ribbons; footer row with muted small texts and badges; ⋮ menu appears on hover top-right.
- **Stage pipeline (statusbar)**: chips with arrow shape (`clip-path` chevron), 33px tall, inactive bg `#E7E9ED` at 50% opacity, current `#E6F2F3` black bold; clickable when allowed; overflow collapses into a dropdown "…".
- **Smart buttons**: 36px tall white boxes with left icon (`fa`), value bold + label small stacked, border `#D8DADD`, hover bg `#F3F4F6`.
- **Notebook tabs**: text `#714B67`, active tab: top border `#714B67`, side borders `#D8DADD`, bottom border white; content padding 16px 0.
- **Chatter**: composer box white with border; message row hover shows action bar; notes have `#FCF8E3`-like background; date separators centered with lines; avatars 36px.
- **Search facets**: chip bg `#E7E9ED` radius 4px 23px tall; left label part bg `#714B67` white with icon (funnel for filter, layers for group-by, star for favorite, magnifier/field name for field search); values joined by " or "; ✕ remove.
- **Pager**: `1-80 / 250` text 14px + `‹ ›` icon buttons 36px with border.
- **Sidebar (search panel)**: 215px, bg `#F9FAFB`, sections with header (uppercase muted), items with counters, active item teal text + `#E6F2F3` bg pill, expand carets.
- **Empty state (`o_nocontent_help`)**: centered block max 800px: illustration (smiling document SVG in purple `#714B67`), h2 21px, p 16.1px, primary CTA when defined; behind it the sample data rows at 6% opacity.
- **Onboarding video card** (Sales quotations, etc.): 400×225 rounded 16px image with play icon centered above the empty-state text.
- **Loading**: `.o_loading_indicator` thin purple bar; skeleton none; buttons show spinner on async.
- **Scrollbars**: thin (8px) overlay style.

Captions under icons are the app names (EN/AR).

### B-6. Layout grid & responsiveness

- Breakpoints (Bootstrap): sm 576, md 768, lg 992, xl 1200, xxl 1400. Form: below md the two-column groups stack; chatter moves below the sheet (and right side ≥ 1500 px); kanban single column below md; navbar collapses app menus into a burger; control panel wraps (search box full width on md); list becomes horizontally scrollable; dialogs go fullscreen on mobile; home menu 3 icons per row on phones.
- Home menu grid: 6 tiles per row, tile 141.67×115, gap 0, container 850px centered, top margin 24px, trial banner above.
- Max content widths: form sheet 1400px; settings content 1200px; financial report sheet 800px; Knowledge article 900px (unless "Full Width").

### B-7. Search panel dropdown (exact)

Panel width ~780px under the search box, 3 equal columns with headers with icon: "Filters" (funnel), "Group By" (layers), "Favorites" (star). Items 14px, active items show ✓ at the left; separators are 1px lines between filter groups; expandable items show a caret at the right and open a nested list (date periods: last 3 months by name, quarters Q4…Q1, years with checkboxes; group-by date interval: Year/Quarter/Month/Week/Day); bottom of Filters: "Add Custom Filter" link (dialog); bottom of Group By: "Custom Group ▾" select of all storable fields; Favorites: "Save current search ▾" → name input (prefilled with action name), "Default filter" and "Shared" checkboxes, "Save"/"Edit" buttons; saved favorites listed with ✓ and trash icon.

### B-8. Empty & sample states

Views with `sample="1"` show ghost sample records (Lorem-ipsum-like names such as "REF0001", "John Miller", "Wendi Baltz", "Henry Campbell", "Thomas Passot", "Carrie Helle", "In massa", "Integer vitae", "Viverra nam", "Laoreet id", "Volutpat blandit", amounts 10k–100k) at 6% opacity beneath the centered help block (`help` text of the action, Part E). Views without sample data show only the help block. Kanban empty columns show "+" placeholders.

### B-9. RTL (Arabic) rules

`<html dir="rtl" lang="ar">` when the user language is `ar_001`. Build the RTL stylesheet with `rtlcss` from the LTR one (all `left/right`, margins, paddings, borders, text-align, floats, transforms flipped). Specifics observed: navbar order reversed (app icon+name and menu sections at the right, systray at the left with avatar leftmost); control panel: primary button + breadcrumb on the right, view switcher on the left; search box centered with the magnifier on the right and the dropdown caret on the left; list: selector column on the right, optional-columns toggler at the far left, text right-aligned, amounts right-aligned as in LTR; form: status bar buttons on the right, stage chips on the left with chevrons pointing left; labels right-aligned; notebook tabs start from the right; kanban columns flow right-to-left; gantt timeline flows right-to-left; chatter unchanged; icons that imply direction (arrows, carets, chevrons, back) mirrored; dates in Arabic-Indic digits (e.g. `٢٤ أغسطس، ١٠:٣٥ ص`), month names Arabic (يناير…ديسمبر), week start Saturday (`week_start=6` in ar_001); numbers/amounts keep Latin digits; date format `%d/%m/%Y` in ar vs `%m/%d/%Y` in en. Untranslated Odoo strings must be translated in the clone.

### B-10. Login page (`/web/login`)

Centered card 246px wide (white, radius 4px, padding 24px, shadow) on the lavender background: company logo placeholder ("📷 Your logo" text-logo in purple when no logo), separator, "Email" label + input (placeholder "Enter your email"), "Password" label + "Reset Password" link right + input (placeholder "Enter your password") + eye toggle, primary full-width "Log in" button, "Don't have an account?" link (signup disabled → hidden or leads to "Sign up is not allowed"), "- or -", outlined "Use a Passkey" button with QR icon, separator, "Powered by Odoo" → replace with "Powered by Rodeo Drive". Error state: red alert "Wrong login/password". Reset password page, signup page, "Set password" invitation page.

## PART C — GLOBAL SHELL, GENERIC BEHAVIOURS AND CUSTOM (NON-GENERIC) SCREENS

### C-1. Navbar (`.o_main_navbar`, 46px, white, bottom hairline)

Left → right (mirrored in RTL):
1. **App icon button** (current app icon 26px, hover bg `#E7E9ED` radius 4px) — click opens the **home menu** (app grid, C-2). Title "Home menu". Hotkey `Alt+H`.
2. **App name** (`o_menu_brand`, 16.8px) — click = go to the app root action.
3. **Menu sections** (`o_menu_sections`): top-level children of the app root menu rendered as text buttons (14px, padding 0 8px, hover bg); items with children open a dropdown (nested children become sub-headers with indented items exactly as the Part E navigation trees). When the navbar is too narrow, overflow goes into a "More ▾" dropdown.
4. **Systray** (`o_menu_systray`, right side, items 26px): in order: **Ask AI** (AI logo image, opens the "Odoo AI" side chat window: header "Odoo AI ▾", minimize/expand/close icons, welcome block "Odoo AI — Your Odoo sidekick for most day-to-day tasks." with suggestion chips "Show me the current cash flow status", "Which projects cost us the most?", "Top 5 sales reps by revenue", input "Message Odoo AI…" with microphone icon — implement with any LLM backend, answering with data from the DB and opening actions); **Messages** (`fa-comments` + red pill counter of unread; opens the Messaging Menu C-1a); **Activities** (`fa-clock-o` + counter; opens Activities menu C-1b); **Odoo Studio** icon (`oi-studio` — in the clone: opens the Studio-like view editor in debug mode, or hide); **company switcher** (when multi-company: dropdown listing companies with checkboxes and "current company" star); **user name** text + **avatar** 26px square with online status dot → user menu (C-1c). Attendance app adds a **check-in/out icon** (red = out / green = in; card with "Check in"/"Check out" button, today's hours, "Total today" and a small clock).

**C-1a. Messaging menu** (panel 475px, white, radius 8px, shadow): tabs "Notifications | Chats | Channels | AI" (active tab has `#E6F2F3` bg pill), right link "New Message" (opens a chat with a person picker); list rows (avatar 36px or channel # icon, bold name, last message preview muted, time at right, unread counter red pill or grey dot when read, "Mark as read" ✓ on hover); special rows: "Install Odoo — Come here often? Install the app for quick and easy access!" with "Install" button; "Turn on notifications — Stay tuned! Enable push notifications to never miss a message." with "Enable" button; OdooBot welcome chat ("Hello, Odoo's chat helps employees collaborate efficiently. I'm here to help you discover its features. Try to send me an emoji :)"); "#General — OdooBot: Welcome to the #General channel 🎉 This is a space for the whole team to connect and share updates."; "Administrators — This is the start of your conversation". Clicking a row opens a **chat window** docked bottom-right (320×450: header with name/avatar, phone/video/expand/close icons; thread; composer) — multiple windows stack; or navigates to Discuss when in the Discuss app.

**C-1b. Activities menu**: panel; when nothing: "Congratulations, you're done with your activities." + "View all activities" link (opens activity view of `mail.activity` grouped by model). Otherwise groups per model (icon, model name, counts "N Late / N Today / N Future" colored) → click opens that model's activity view or list filtered "My Activities"; "Summary" actions.

**C-1c. User menu** (large panel): "Help" (opens support/doc link), "Shortcuts CTRL+K" (opens command palette), separator, "● Online ▸" (submenu: Online / Away / Do not disturb, with custom status text and duration), "My Preferences" (opens `res.users` preferences form in a dialog — Part G: tabs Preferences (Language, Timezone, Notification "Handle by Emails/Odoo", Email signature, Theme?) and Account Security (change password, 2FA, API keys, passkeys), Calendar/Discuss options), "My databases", "My subscription" (SaaS links → in the clone: "My Subscription" page of Rodeo), separator, "Install App" (PWA install prompt), "Log out". Debug mode adds "Odoo.com Account", "Documentation", "Support".

### C-2. Home menu (`/odoo`)

Full-screen lavender background (B-1), navbar transparent showing only the systray; yellow trial banner (when applicable) centered above the grid; grid of app tiles (icon + caption) in the order of the root menus with sequence: Discuss, Calendar, Appointments, To-do, Knowledge, Sales, Dashboards, Rental, Accounting, Documents, Project, Planning, Helpdesk, Surveys, Purchase, Sign, Employees, Attendances, Fleet, Approvals, Apps, Settings. Typing while on the home menu opens the command palette search filtered to menus (`/`). Arrow keys move the focus ring between tiles; Enter opens. Apps are shown only if the user belongs to a group of that app.

### C-3. Command palette (`Ctrl+K`)

Modal 500px: input "Search for a command…"; default list: contextual commands from the current view (Save ALT+S, Discard ALT+J, Search… ALT+Q, New/Create, Duplicate, Delete, Export…), global: Activity ALT+SHIFT+A, Add a To-Do ALT+SHIFT+T, Show My Activities, Show All Activities, Switch Company ALT+SHIFT+U, Ask AI, "Go to Discuss", "Toggle debug mode"; footer tip "TIP — search for /menus, @conversations and ?articles". Prefixes: `/` menus (all menu paths "App / Section / Item"), `@` users & partners (open chat), `#` channels, `?` Knowledge articles ("Advanced Search ALT+B"), `!` (debug) technical.

### C-4. Action manager, breadcrumbs, URLs

Every menu click loads an action (Part E lists them as S-numbers). URL `/odoo/<path>` where `path` is the action's slug (e.g. `/odoo/sales`, `/odoo/orders`, `/odoo/customer-invoices`, `/odoo/discuss`, `/odoo/knowledge/32`, `/odoo/documents`, `/odoo/planning`, `/odoo/attendances`, `/odoo/accounting`, `/odoo/balance-sheet`, `/odoo/profit-and-loss`, `/odoo/settings`, `/odoo/apps`, `/odoo/users`, `/odoo/companies`); actions without a slug use `/odoo/action-<id>`; record: `/odoo/orders/12`, new: `/odoo/orders/new`; view type `?view_type=kanban`; nested breadcrumbs: `/odoo/orders/12/action-448` etc. Breadcrumb shows parents as teal links, current as text; when the stack gets long, older crumbs collapse into "…" (Sign template form shows "… / Sample Contract.pdf"). Browser back/forward navigate the stack. Dialogs (`target: new`) don't change URL.

### C-5. Generic record features available on every model with chatter (`mail.thread`)

Messages/notes/activities/followers/attachments (A-4 §17); "Send message" sends email to followers (with the email template of the model when defined: e.g. "Sales: Send Quotation" template with PDF attached); tracking of changes; activity plans ("Schedule activity plan" from the chatter: applies a list of activities, e.g. onboarding plans); rating emails; portal share; "Print" menu PDFs; "Export"; import; archive; duplicate; delete; keyboard navigation between records; "Discard changes" guard; auto-save; concurrent-edit warning ("The record has been modified, your changes will be discarded…"); required-field validation (red underline + "Invalid fields:" dialog listing labels); onchange warnings; access error dialogs; record rules.

### C-6. Settings page (`res.config.settings`) behaviour

One page for all apps (Part F): left sidebar app list (icon + name; active = teal text) scrolls the content to the app block; "Save" applies all values (`execute` re-installs modules for `module_*` toggles, creates related records), "Discard" reloads; search box filters settings live (non-matching blocks hidden, matches highlighted); each `SETTING` renders as a 2-column responsive card: left checkbox/toggle (when the first field is boolean) + bold label + help text + "documentation ↗" link when `documentation` attr, then dependent fields appear indented when enabled (`invisible` conditions); `company_dependent` shows a building icon; `groups` restrictions hide the setting; `type="header"` settings render as section headers with a company selector. Buttons inside settings (`→ Manage Users`, `→ Add Languages`, `Invite` button with email input, `→ Configure document layout`, `→ Update` etc.) open the actions listed in Part F. Hash anchors `#sale_management`, `#discuss_setting`, `#account`… select the app block.

### C-7. Login, signup, password reset, invitations, sessions

See B-10. Invitation flow: Settings › Users › Invite → email with "Set password" link. Session expiry → "Your session expired" dialog → re-login keeps the URL. Passkeys (WebAuthn) via Cognito or custom. 2FA (TOTP) in My Preferences › Account Security with QR. API keys page ("New API key" with scope + description → shows key once). "Log out" → `/web/login`. Kiosk URLs (attendance) are public token URLs. Portal share links (`/my/orders/<id>?access_token=`) render a customer portal (quotation accept & sign & pay page, invoice view/pay, helpdesk ticket, project task, sign document signing page, survey answering page, appointment booking page, calendar invite accept/decline page) — implement these public pages with Odoo's portal look (white cards on light grey, company header).

Control panel shows only the title "Dashboards". Content: read-only spreadsheet rendering (white canvas, scroll) with: **scorecard** tiles (grey label 12px, value 32px light, baseline line "↑ 1900.0% since last period" green / "↓" red / "= 0%"), **charts** (line/area, bar, pie, treemap, gauge, waterfall, radar) with titles, **tables** with conditional formatting data bars, section titles bold teal-blue, global filters bar at the top when defined (date range period selector, relational filters like Salesperson/Team). Dashboards & their contents (recreate with real data queries):
- **Sales**: scorecards Quotations / Orders / Revenue / Average Order (each "since last period", comparing current vs previous period of the filter); chart "Monthly Sales" (area, revenue per month); tables "Top Quotations" (partner, revenue), "Top Customers" (Customer / Orders / Revenue), "Top Sales Teams", "Top Sources" (utm), "Top Salespeople" (user_id, revenue), country map/treemap of sales.
- **Product**: scorecards "Best Seller" (product name, "N sold"), "Best Category" (category, "N sold"); charts "Best Sellers by Revenue" (bar), "Best Sellers by Units Sold" (bar); table "Best Selling Products" (Product / Category / Units / Revenue).
- **Rental**: scorecards Rentals / Revenue / Quotations; chart "Daily Rentals" (area); tables Category, "Top Salespeople" (Salesperson / Ordered / Revenue), "Top Products", "Top Customers"; KPIs Quotations, Orders, Ordered Qty, Picked-up Qty, Returned Qty, Revenue.
- **Accounting**: scorecards Current income (vs last period), Receivables ("to receive"), Current expense, Payables ("to pay"); chart "Invoiced" (area by month); KPI table with Δ vs previous year: Cash (Cash received, Cash spent, Cash surplus, Closing bank balance), Performance (Gross profit margin, Net profit margin, Return on investments, Financial independence), Position (Average debtors days, Average creditors days, Short term cash forecast), Liquidity (Cash asset ratio, Quick ratio, Current assets to liabilities, Working capital), Profitability (Income, Cost of revenue, Gross profit, Expenses, Net profit), Balance sheet (Receivable, Payables, Net assets), Solvency (Debt to Equity, Solvency, Debt ratio, Permanence, Financial balance).
- **Invoicing**: scorecards Invoiced (baseline "N unpaid"), Average Invoice ("N Invoices"), DSO ("N days", "in current year"); chart "Invoiced by Month"; tables "Top Invoices" (Reference / Customer / Salesperson / Status Paid|Not Paid|Partially Paid), Country, "Top Products".
- **Benchmark**: 10 gauges with explanations: Gross profit margin ((Net sales – COGS)/Net sales; >50% hugely profitable business; <20% hard to become profitable; possible issue in the business model), Net profit margin (Net income/Revenue; <3% not efficient; >10% very efficient; possible issue in direct and indirect costs), Operating margin (EBIT/Net sales; <5% / >10%; possible issue in COGS), Debt-to-equity (Total liabilities/Total shareholders' equity; <2.5 mature company; >5 lots of debt; possible issue in resources allocation), Current ratio (Current assets/Current liabilities; >1.5 strong; <1 weak; possible issue with asset distribution and cash availability), Cash flow ratio (Cash flow/Current liabilities; >1 / <0.8; number of times you can pay off current debts with cash generated per year), Working capital (Current assets – Current liabilities; >0 / <0; possible issues in cash availability at short term), Quick ratio (Quick assets/Current liabilities; >1 highly solvent; <0.7 stuck with non liquid assets), Average debtor days (Sales on account/Average AR; <45 / >60; possible issue in payment terms), Average payable days (Net credit purchases/Average AP; <45 / >60).
- **Helpdesk**: scorecards Tickets, Rating (x/5), Time to Assign (h), Time to Respond (h), Time to Close (h); pie "Ticket Stage" (New / In Progress / Solved / Cancelled), stacked bars tickets per team by stage (Customer Care, VIP Support, IT Support (Auto Assign)), tables "Top Customers", "Tickets by Tags" (Service, Repair).
Configuration › Dashboards: list grouped by section (name, section, sequence, published toggle "Publish", spreadsheet file, "Access groups"), form; Sections list (editable name/sequence); Share links list. From any pivot/graph: ⚙ → "Insert in Spreadsheet" → dialog "Select a spreadsheet to insert your pivot/chart" (Blank spreadsheet / existing dashboards & templates) → opens the spreadsheet editor (implement a spreadsheet editor with formulas `=ODOO.PIVOT()`, `=ODOO.LIST()`, charts, scorecards — a Univer/Handsontable-based editor is acceptable as long as the dashboard rendering matches).

Cards: ★ favorite, name, responsible avatar + date, badge "Shared", tags, counters "N In Progress" / "N Signed", buttons "Send" and "Sign Now", ⋮ (Edit Template, Duplicate, Archive, Delete, Properties). Documents (`sign.request`) kanban/list: cards with state badges (To Sign / Signed / Cancelled / Expired / Shared), signers with status dots, "Sign"/"Resend"/"Cancel"/"Download" buttons; "My Documents" vs "All Documents"; reports "Green Savings" (illustrated counters: sheets of paper, water (L), CO₂ (kg), trees, energy — computed from signed pages).
**Template editor**: control panel: "Send" (primary), "Sign Now" (primary), "Share" (secondary), breadcrumb "Templates / <name>" + ⚙ (Save as Template, Configuration, Preview), right "Tags" many2many. Left sidebar 320px: "Documents" section with "Add" (attach more PDFs to the template) listing PDFs with ✎ rename and ⋮ (Edit, Delete); "Signers" section with "Add" (roles: `sign.item.role` — Signer 1, Customer, Company, Employee…; each row: role name, counter pill (fields assigned), ⋮ Edit role (name, "auth method" SMS/none, color), Delete); field palette buttons (purple-tinted, 2 columns, icon + label): Signature, Initials, Name, Email, Phone, Company, Text, Multiline, Checkbox, Radio, Selection, Date, Strikethrough, Stamp, "+ Add Field" (custom field types). Center: PDF toolbar (search, "+", zoom % select, "−", page "N of M", ‹ ›, right panel toggle) and the PDF pages (white on grey with diagonal watermark) — drag fields from the palette onto pages; field boxes are light-purple, resizable (handle bottom-right), show role name as handwritten preview for signature/initials, draggable, keyboard nudge; click → popover (title = type, "Placeholder" textarea, "Mandatory field" checkbox, role select "Responsible", alignment (text), "Default value"/"Auto-fill" for Name/Email/Phone/Company, options list for Selection/Radio, text size), footer Save (primary) + duplicate + delete icons; Ctrl+C/V copy fields; "Auto-detect" fields (optional). Configuration dialog (from ⚙): Name, Available in (All apps / Documents…), Documents folder; footer Save / Discard / More Options (→ full template form S-ref with Available in, Authorized Users, Owner, CC, Valid for N days, Tags, Documents folder, Redirect Link, tabs Communication (default message) & Signers, "ARCHIVED" ribbon when archived; smart button "Signed Document N"). **Send dialog "New Signature Request"**: per role "Signer N" contact input ("Type a name or email…" — creates partner on the fly), "Valid Until" date (default +60 days) with `?` tooltip, "Reminders" checkbox (→ "every N days"), "Hide certificate key on pages" checkbox; "Subject" (default "Signature Request - <template name>"), "CC" (contacts, tooltip), message editor placeholder "Enter your message"; footer: "Send" (primary), "Discard", attachment icon, tags icon, AI icon, ⏱ schedule. **"Sign Now"** dialog: same with current user as Signer 1 and "Sign Now" button → opens the signing screen. **Share** dialog "Share Document": "Share Link" read-only URL + copy icon, "Valid Until" ("No expiration"), footer "Stop sharing" (primary), "Copy link", "Close".
**Signing page** (`/sign/document/<id>/<token>`, public): top bar with company logo, document name, "Sign Document"/"Validate & Send Completed Document" primary, navigation arrows between required fields, PDF with highlighted fields; signature dialog (tabs Auto (typed name in handwriting fonts, font picker), Draw (canvas, clear), Load (upload image); "Adopt and Sign"), initials, text inputs, checkboxes, date auto-filled, selection dropdown; "Refuse" link with reason; completion page "Thank You! The document has been signed" with "Download document" and "Download certificate"; "Sign in" prompt for internal signers. Certificate PDF: audit log with IPs/dates/hashes. Signed PDF stored in Documents folder "Sign".
Config › Fields: `sign.item.type` list/form (Name, Type, Tip, Placeholder, Auto-fill partner field, default width/height); Tags; Settings block (see Part F: "Sign" app: default signature validity, Identify by SMS, email reminders, "Terms & Conditions", etc.).

#### C-8.6 Attendances (Overview gantt, Kiosk, systray)
Overview: `hr.attendance` **gantt** (S-ref in Part E) — control panel "New" + "Attendances ⚙"; gantt toolbar ‹ › "Day ▾" "Today" ⤢; left column header "Days"; date header + hours 12am…11pm (today/current hour highlighted); rows per employee; empty-state onboarding card: "Ready to track attendances?" — tablet illustration ("Scan your badge", "Identify Manually") + "Try the kiosk" (primary → opens kiosk URL in a new tab), and check-in illustration + "Try the top ● icon (e.g for work from home)", "or", "Try the backend and reporting:" + "Load sample data" (creates sample attendances). List views for Management (approve overtime: buttons Approve/Refuse), Reporting (pivot/graph of attendances & overtime).
**Kiosk** (`/hr_attendance/<kiosk-token>`, public, full-screen, logs out the backend session when opened in the same browser): background lavender; top-left clock 48px + weekday + date (localized); top-right company logo; dismissible alert "Connect an RFID reader, and scan a token. 'Read the Documentation' / 'Buy an RFID Device' ✕"; center white card (radius 12px): barcode illustration, "Scan your badge", "Install" pill (PWA); bottom-left pill button "👤 Identify Manually"; bottom-right "Powered by …". Manual: grey bg, top bar "‹ Back" pill + search input; left card with departments list ("All", "Administration (0)") and right grid of employee cards (avatar 64px, name); click → PIN keypad (if "Employee PIN" enabled: 0-9, ⌫, OK) → **greeting screen**: big avatar, "Welcome <name>" / "Goodbye <name>", "Checked in/out at HH:MM", worked hours today & total, overtime indicator, "OK" button, auto-return after 5 s; kiosk mode setting: Barcode/RFID, Manual selection, Both; "Attendance from Backend/Kiosk/Systray" settings. Systray icon: red circle (checked out) / green (checked in); click → card: "Check in"/"Check out" big button (green/red), today's worked time counter running live, "Total today", geolocation note if enabled.

**Dashboard** (`account.journal` kanban with `js_class="account_dashboard_kanban"`, `/odoo/accounting`): control panel "Dashboard ⚙", search default facet "Favorites", pager; 2-column grid of journal cards (white, radius 4px, colored 3px left border by journal color; title = journal name link; subtitle hint; body per type): Sales ("Get Paid online. Send electronic invoices." + "New" button + mini bar chart of invoices due by week: Due / 6 - 12 Sep / This Week / 20 - 26 Sep / 27 Sep - 3 Oct / Not Due; stats "N to check", "N unpaid invoices: amount", "Late"); Purchases ("Let artificial intelligence scan your bill. Pay easily." + "Upload" button + drop zone "Drag & drop" or "Create a bill manually" link; stats); Bank ("Connect your bank. Match invoices automatically." + bank tiles: "Search over 26 000 banks" (purple), Citibank N.A. - Business, HSBCnet - Business, Standard Chartered - Business, Belfius, ING, CaixaBank, BNP Paribas, BBVA, Sabadell → online sync wizard (institution search, credentials, consent); after setup: balance line chart, "N to reconcile" button "Reconcile", "Latest statement", "Balance in GL", import statement (CSV/OFX/QIF/CAMT) button); Cash (Balance, "New Transaction"); Tax Returns ("Tax Returns" button + onboarding checklist ● Set Company Data ● Set Periods ● Review Chart of Accounts, each opening its wizard; done steps get ✓ green); Miscellaneous ("New Entry", stats). Card ⋮ → panel with columns View / New / Reporting (per type as listed in the custom-screens notes), color picker 12 swatches, "★ Remove from/Add to Favorites", "Configuration" (journal form). Drag & drop cards reorder (`sequence`). Kanban search: filters (Favorites, Sales, Purchase, Bank, Cash, Miscellaneous; group by type). Onboarding banner at top (collapsible) when no invoices: steps "Company Data", "Bank Account", "Chart of Accounts", "Invoice Layout", "Create invoice", "Taxes".
**Financial report client action** (`account_report`, one per menu: Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss, Cash Flow Statement, Executive Summary, Trial Balance, General Ledger, Journal Audit, Partner Ledger (+ variants Customer Statement, Open Items), Aged Receivable, Aged Payable, Tax Report (+ Group by Account>Tax, Tax>Account), Deferred Revenue, Deferred Expense, Bank Matching (Bank Reconciliation Report), Fiscal Report, Depreciation Schedule (+ Group by Account / Asset Group), Unrealized Currency Gains/Losses, EC Sales List, Annual Report): control panel: "Print ▾" primary (PDF, XLSX), title + ⚙ (Save / Copy to spreadsheet / Annotations), filter buttons row: "📅 <period>" (panel: Month ‹ September 2026 ›, Quarter ‹ Jul 2026 - Sep 2026 ›, Fiscal Year ‹ 2026 › ✓, Custom Dates from→to; for single-date reports "As of"), "Comparison" (No Comparison ✓ / Previous Period / Same Period Last Year / Percentage of / Custom Dates; "Period order: Descending ▾"; "Comparison in: Percentage ▾ / Number"; N periods), "⚙ Posted Entries, Accrual Basis" (options: Draft Entries, Subtotals, Unfold All, Cash Basis Method, Hide lines at 0, Analytic (groupby), Journals (multi-select), Partners, Account types (Receivable/Payable/both), Budgets, Multi-ledger, "Group by" chips), "📊 Budget", currency "In .QR", "Hierarchy" toggle, "Partner"/"Account" filters as per report; body: centered white sheet (max 800px for statements; full width for ledgers) with table: column headers per report (Part D-13 list), line hierarchy with indentation by level, foldable lines with caret (unfold loads journal items with "Load more"), total lines highlighted (grey bar, bold), values muted when 0.00, click on amount → journal items list (drilldown) or "Audit"/"Annotate" hover icons, growth columns with green/red % , annotations (sticky notes) rows, footer "Load more". Print: PDF with company header; XLSX. Tax Return screen (`account.return` kanban): cards per period with checklist (checks from `account.return.check.template`), "Review"/"Submit"/"Pay" flow, deadline badges. Lock Dates wizard (Part E). Bank Matching (reconciliation widget, `account.bank.statement.line` kanban `js_class` reconcile): left list of statement lines (amount, partner, label, date, "Validate" / "Reset" buttons), right: matching candidates tabs "Match existing entries" (list with checkboxes), "Manual operations" (account, label, amount, tax, analytic), "Discuss" (chatter); "Reconciliation models" buttons row; filters "Not matched / Matched / Statement".

Default categories: Business Trip, Borrow Items, General Approval, Contract Approval, Payment Application, Car Rental Application, Job Referral Award, Procurement, Create RFQ's (field configs in Part I).

### C-13. Financial report definitions (account.report) — filters, columns, line structure (EN / AR)

Each report is rendered by the generic financial report screen (C-8.7). `filters` lists the filter buttons/options available on that report (`date_range` = from/to period vs single date; `period_comparison`; `growth_comparison` adds % columns; `unfold_all`; `hide_0_lines`; `show_draft` = 'Draft Entries' option; `journals`; `partner`; `account_type`; `analytic_groupby`; `cash_basis`; `budgets`; `hierarchy`; `unreconciled`; `multi_company`). `default_period` is the initial date filter. Lines are indented by level (0 = section header bold bar, 1/3/5 = nested).


**Balance Sheet** — default period: `today`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `show_draft`, `unfold_all`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `period_comparison`, `growth_comparison`, `line_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`, `analytic_groupby`, `cash_basis`; columns: `Balance:monetary`
- ASSETS / الأصول
  - Current Assets / الأصول المتداولة (under ASSETS)
    - Bank and Cash Accounts / الحسابات البنكية والنقدية (under Current Assets)
    - Receivables / المدينين (under Current Assets)
    - Current Assets / الأصول المتداولة (under Current Assets)
    - Prepayments / المدفوعات المسددة مقدمًا (under Current Assets)
  - Fixed Assets / الأصول الثابتة (under ASSETS)
  - Non-current Assets / الأصول غير المتداولة (under ASSETS)
- LIABILITIES / التزامات
  - Current Liabilities / الالتزامات الجارية (under LIABILITIES)
    - Current Liabilities / الالتزامات الجارية (under Current Liabilities)
    - Credit Card / البطاقة الائتمانية (under Current Liabilities)
    - Payables / الدائنون (under Current Liabilities)
  - Non-current Liabilities / الالتزامات غير الجارية (under LIABILITIES)
- EQUITY (& EARNINGS) / الأسهم (والأرباح)
  - Equity / رأس المال (under EQUITY (& EARNINGS))
  - Earnings / الأرباح (under EQUITY (& EARNINGS))
    - Current Year Unallocated Earnings / الأرباح غير المخصصة للسنة الجارية (under Earnings)
    - Previous Years Earnings (under Earnings)
  - Other Comprehensive Income (under EQUITY (& EARNINGS))
    - Cumulative Translation Adjustments / تعديلات الترجمة التراكمية (under Other Comprehensive Income)
- LIABILITIES + EQUITY / الالتزامات + رأس المال
- OFF BALANCE SHEET ACCOUNTS / الحسابات خارج الميزانية العمومية

**Cash Flow Statement** — default period: `previous_month`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `unfold_all`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `growth_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`; columns: `Balance:monetary`
- Cash and cash equivalents, beginning of period
- Net increase in cash and cash equivalents
- Cash flows from operating activities (Advance Payments received from customers, Cash received from operating activities, Advance payments made to suppliers, Cash paid for operating activities)
- Cash flows from investing & extraordinary activities (Cash in, Cash out)
- Cash flows from financing activities (Cash in, Cash out)
- Cash flows from unclassified activities (Cash in, Cash out)
- Cash and cash equivalents, closing balance

**Executive Summary** — default period: `this_year`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `period_comparison`, `growth_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`, `cash_basis`; columns: `Balance:monetary`
- Cash / نقدي
  - Cash received / الأرباح النقدية (under Cash)
  - Cash spent / المبلغ المُنفَق (under Cash)
  - Cash surplus / الفائض النقدي (under Cash)
  - Closing bank balance / رصيد الإقفال البنكي (under Cash)
- Profitability / الربحية
  - Revenue / الإيرادات (under Profitability)
  - Cost of Revenue / تكاليف الإيرادات (under Profitability)
  - Gross profit / إجمالي الربح (under Profitability)
  - Expenses / النفقات (under Profitability)
  - Net Profit / صافي الربح (under Profitability)
- Balance Sheet / الميزانية العمومية
  - Receivables / المدينين (under Balance Sheet)
  - Payables / الدائنون (under Balance Sheet)
  - Net assets / صافي الأصول (under Balance Sheet)
- Performance / الأداء
  - Gross profit margin (gross profit / operating income) / إجمالي هامش الربح (إجمالي الربح / الدخل التشغيلي) (under Performance)
  - Net profit margin (net profit / revenue) / صافي هامش الربح (صافي الربح / الإيرادات) (under Performance)
  - Return on investments (net profit / assets) / العائد على الاستثمار (صافي الربح / الأصول) (under Performance)
- Position / المنصب الوظيفي
  - Average debtors days / متوسط أيام المدينين (under Position)
  - Average creditors days / متوسط أيام الدائنين (under Position)
  - Short term cash forecast / توقعات النقد قصيرة الأجل (under Position)
  - Current assets to liabilities / نسبة الأصول المتداولة إلى الالتزامات (under Position)

**Bank Reconciliation Report (Bank Matching)** — default period: `today`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `show_draft`, `hide_0_lines=by_default`, `growth_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`; columns: `Date:date`, `Label:string`, `Amount Currency:monetary`, `Currency:string`, `Amount:monetary`
- Balance of Bank / رصيد البنك
  - Last statement balance / رصيد آخر كشف حساب (under Balance of Bank)
  - Including Unreconciled Receipts / شاملة الإيصالات غير المسواة (under Last statement balance)
  - Including Unreconciled Payments / شاملة المدفوعات غير المسواة (under Last statement balance)
  - Transactions without statement / المعاملات التي ليس لها كشف حساب (under Balance of Bank)
  - Including Unreconciled Receipts (under Transactions without statement)
  - Including Unreconciled Payments (under Transactions without statement)
  - Misc. operations / العمليات المتنوعة (under Balance of Bank)
- Outstanding Receipts/Payments / المدفوعات/الإيصالات المستحقة
  - (+) Outstanding Receipts / (+) الإيصالات المستحقة (under Outstanding Receipts/Payments)
  - (-) Outstanding Payments / (-) المدفوعات المستحقة (under Outstanding Receipts/Payments)

**Aged Receivable** / المتأخر المدين — default period: `today`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `show_draft`, `unreconciled`, `unfold_all`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `growth_comparison`, `account_type=receivable`, `partner`; columns: `Invoice Date:date`, `Amount Currency:monetary`, `Currency:string`, `Account:string`, `At Date:monetary`, `Period 1:monetary`, `Period 2:monetary`, `Period 3:monetary`, `Period 4:monetary`, `Older:monetary`, `Total:monetary`
- Aged Receivable (grouped by partner, unfoldable to invoices)

**Aged Payable** / حسابات دائنة مستحقة متأخرة — default period: `today`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `show_draft`, `unreconciled`, `unfold_all`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `growth_comparison`, `account_type=payable`, `partner`; columns: `Invoice Date:date`, `Amount Currency:monetary`, `Currency:string`, `Account:string`, `At Date:monetary`, `Period 1:monetary`, `Period 2:monetary`, `Period 3:monetary`, `Period 4:monetary`, `Older:monetary`, `Total:monetary`
- Aged Payable (grouped by partner)

**General Ledger** / دفتر الأستاذ العام — default period: `this_month`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `unfold_all`, `growth_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`, `analytic_groupby`, `cash_basis`; columns: `Date:date`, `Partner:string`, `Currency:monetary`, `Debit:monetary`, `Credit:monetary`, `Balance:monetary`

**EC Sales List** — default period: `previous_month`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `growth_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`; columns: `Country Code:string`, `VAT Number:string`, `Amount:monetary`

**Partner Ledger** / دفتر الأستاذ العام للشركاء — default period: `this_year`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `unreconciled`, `unfold_all`, `growth_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`, `account_type=both`, `partner`; columns: `Journal:string`, `Account:string`, `Invoice Date:date`, `Due Date:date`, `Matching:string`, `Debit:monetary`, `Credit:monetary`, `Amount Currency:monetary`, `Balance:monetary`, `Residual:monetary`, `Residual Currency:monetary`

**Profit and Loss** — default period: `this_year`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `unfold_all`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `period_comparison`, `growth_comparison`, `line_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`, `budgets`, `analytic_groupby`, `cash_basis`; columns: `Balance:monetary`
  - Revenue / الإيرادات

- Gross Profit / إجمالي الربح

- variants: Group by: Account > Tax; Group by: Tax > Account

**Annual Statements (Annual Report / Audit working file)** — default period: `previous_month`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `period_comparison`, `growth_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`

**Fiscal Report** — default period: `previous_year`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `unfold_all`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `period_comparison`, `growth_comparison`, `hierarchy=optional`; columns: `Base Total:monetary`, `Rate:percentage`, `Fiscal Amount:monetary`

**Depreciation Schedule** / جدول الإهلاك — default period: `previous_year`; filters: `multi_company=selector`, `date_range`, `show_draft`, `unfold_all`, `hide_0_lines=optional`, `growth_comparison`, `analytic_groupby`; columns: `Acquisition Date:date`, `Method:string`, `Rate:string`, `Assets: date from, +, -, date to`, `Depreciation: date from, +, -, date to`, `Book Value:monetary`
- variants: Group by: Account; Group by: Asset Group

---

## PART D — CROSS-APP BUSINESS LOGIC: STATE MACHINES, BUTTON METHODS, COMPUTED FIELDS, INTEGRATIONS

All apps operate on ONE shared database: `res.partner` (customers/vendors/contacts/employees' private addresses), `res.users`, `res.company`, `res.currency`, `product.template`/`product.product`, `uom.uom`, `account.*`, `mail.*`. Every model with a chatter posts a message for every state change (system message text given below). Each button listed in Part E under `HEADER` maps to a method here. Where a method is not described, implement Odoo's standard behaviour (Odoo 17/18/19 semantics).

### D-1. Numbering (ir.sequence) — never reuse, never skip on error (transaction), per company

| Model | Trigger | Sequence code | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| sale.order | create (quotation) | `sale.order` | `S00001` (prefix "S", padding 5) |
| sale.order (rental) | create | same sequence | `S00002` |
| account.move customer invoice | on **Post** (draft shows `INV/2026/` "/" placeholder "Draft") | journal `INV` | `INV/2026/00001` (year-based, resets yearly) |
| account.move customer credit note | on Post | journal INV refund seq | `RINV/2026/00001` |
| account.move vendor bill | on Post | journal `BILL` | `BILL/2026/09/0001` (year/month) |
| vendor credit note | on Post | | `RBILL/2026/09/0001` |
| journal entry (misc) | on Post | journal `MISC` | `MISC/2026/09/0001` |
| account.payment | on Confirm | journal payment seq | `PBNK1/2026/00001` (bank), `PCSH1/2026/00001` (cash) |
| bank statement | | | `BNK1/2026/00001` |
| purchase.order | create | `purchase.order` | `P00001` |
| approval.request | create when category `automated_sequence` | category `sequence_code` | e.g. `BT00001` |
| helpdesk.ticket | create | `helpdesk.ticket` | `#1`, `#2` (ticket_ref integer) |
| project.task | create | none (id) | tasks show `#id` |
| sign.request | create | reference = template name + `#N` | |
| fleet.vehicle | | license plate | |
| survey user input | access token uuid | | |
| planning.slot | none | | |
| hr.employee | `barcode` (badge) auto "00…" 10 digits when generated | | |
| calendar.event, appointment bookings | uuid tokens | | |
| documents.document | `access_token` | | |

### D-2. Sales (`sale.order`, `sale.order.line`) — Sales + Rental apps

- **States**: `draft` "Quotation" → `sent` "Quotation Sent" → `sale` "Sales Order"; `cancel` "Cancelled". Pipeline shows `draft,sent,sale`. `locked` boolean (Lock/Unlock) prevents edits after confirmation when setting "Lock Confirmed Sales" is on.
- **Buttons**: `action_quotation_send` (opens mail composer with template "Sales: Send Quotation" + PDF `sale.action_report_saleorder`; on send: state→`sent`; posts "Quotation sent"), `action_confirm` (validate lines, set `date_order=now` if empty, state→`sale`, `commitment_date` default, create analytic account if service tracking, create project/tasks for `service_tracking` products (task_global_project → task in the product's project; task_in_project → new project + task; project_only → new project), create planning slots for products with planning role (`planning_hours_to_plan`), send confirmation email if setting "Automatic email on confirmation", lock if setting, post "Sales Order confirmed", generate invoice automatically if `require_payment` paid), `action_cancel` (confirm dialog text in Part E; opens "Cancel order" wizard when emails were sent: options "Send cancellation email"/"Cancel anyway"; state→`cancel`), `action_draft` "Set to Quotation" (from cancel → draft), `action_unlock`, `action_preview_sale_order` (opens portal `/my/orders/<id>?access_token=`: customer page with "Accept & Sign" (signature pad), "Pay now" (payment providers), "Reject", PDF download, chat), `Create Invoice` → wizard `sale.advance.payment.inv` (S-ref 448: options "Regular invoice", "Down payment (percentage)", "Down payment (fixed amount)", amount/percentage, deduct down payments, "Create Draft"/"Create and View Invoice"; creates `account.move` `out_invoice` from lines with `qty_to_invoice` > 0 using invoice policy: `order` = ordered qty, `delivery` = delivered qty; links `invoice_lines`; sets `invoice_status`), `Download` (PDF report), `action_open_pickup` / `action_open_return` (rental: pickup wizard marks `qty_delivered`, `rental_status` = `return`; return wizard marks `qty_returned`, status `returned`; late statuses computed vs `rental_start_date`/`rental_return_date` → `is_late`), `action_update_rental_prices` (recompute line prices from rental pricing rules for the duration), `payment_action_capture`/`payment_action_void` (authorized online payments), `action_reopen_order` (reopen invoicing when `invoicing_closed`).
- **Smart buttons**: Invoices (count → invoices list filtered by `invoice_ids`), Projects/Tasks (from service lines), Planning (`action_view_planning` gantt filtered by SO), Purchase orders (`purchase_order_count` — POs generated from subcontracting/"to purchase" lines), Spreadsheet (`spreadsheet_template_id` for quote calculators), Payment transactions.
- **Computed**: `amount_untaxed`, `amount_tax`, `amount_total` (sum of lines, taxes per `tax_ids` with price-included handling, rounding per company `tax_calculation_rounding_method`), `tax_totals` JSON (groups by tax group for the totals widget), `invoice_status`: `no` if draft/cancel or nothing to invoice; `to invoice` if any line `qty_to_invoice != 0`; `invoiced` if all invoiced; `upselling` when delivered > ordered on ordered-policy service lines; `delivery_status` (pending/started/partial/full from `qty_delivered`), `expected_date` (max line lead time), `validity_date` default = today + "Default Quotation Validity" days (30), `payment_term_id` from partner, `pricelist_id` from partner, `currency_id` from pricelist/company, `user_id`/`team_id` from partner or current user, `partner_invoice_id`/`partner_shipping_id` from partner addresses, `note` from company "Default Terms and Conditions", `require_signature`/`require_payment`/`prepayment_percent` from settings, `client_order_ref`, `origin`, `tag_ids`, `sale_order_template_id` (applying a template fills lines, note, validity, options), `duplicated_order_ids` warning, `partner_credit_warning` (credit limit), `sale_warning_text` (partner sale warning), `has_archived_products`, `document_tax_mode` (tax_included/tax_excluded display).
- **Lines** (`sale.order.line`): `display_type` (line_section / line_subsection / line_note / product), `sequence` (handle), `product_template_id`/`product_id` (variant selection → product configurator dialog when template has attributes: attribute values, "no_variant" attributes, custom values, optional products), `name` (product description default = display name + description_sale), `product_uom_qty`, `product_uom_id`, `price_unit` (from pricelist rules × qty, or product `list_price`), `discount` (%), `tax_ids` (product taxes mapped by fiscal position), `price_subtotal`/`price_total`, `qty_delivered` (manual for services when `qty_delivered_method='manual'`; from timesheets/milestones/stock otherwise), `qty_invoiced`, `qty_to_invoice`, `invoice_status`, `customer_lead` (days), `is_downpayment`, `linked_line_id`/`combo_item_id` (combo products create child lines), `is_optional` sections (optional products in quotes shown to customers who can add them), `collapse_composition`/`collapse_prices` (section display options), `product_document_ids` (documents attached to products shown in quotation PDF), `planning_slot_ids`, `is_rental`/`is_product_rentable` (rental lines with `rental_start_date`… pickup/return quantities `qty_returned`), `technical_price_unit`, `analytic_distribution` (analytic accounts %), `product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids`, `product_custom_attribute_value_ids`.
