- Apps (`ir.module.module`): kanban (Part E S-ref 36) of applications with Install/Upgrade/Uninstall; in the clone all 22 apps are "installed"; optional modules toggled by settings `module_*` fields (e.g. `module_sale_margin`, `module_delivery`, `module_hr_timesheet`, `module_account_budget`, `module_sign_itsme`…) — implement each as a feature flag that reveals the related UI listed in Part F.

### D-17. Reports (PDF) — implement all (Part I `ir.actions.report` 34 records)

Quotation / Order (sale), Pro-forma invoice, Invoices / Credit notes (account.move; with/without payments; "Invoice with payment info"), Payment receipt, Purchase Order / Request for Quotation, Approval Request, Print Badge (employee), Planning schedule ("Print"), Fleet? (none), Survey (certification PDF, survey results), Sign (signed document + certificate), Helpdesk? (none), Project? (none), Calendar? (none), Rental (pickup/return slip? — "Order" report reused), Accounting reports (financial statements PDF/XLSX), Audit trail, Journal audit, Follow-up letters, Green savings? (screen only). All PDFs use the company document layout (`external_report_layout_id`, colors, fonts) with header (logo, company address), footer (company details, page numbers "Page 1 / 2"), paper format A4 with margins; "Print" downloads or opens in a viewer per user preference "Print → download/open".

## PART E — THE 22 APPLICATIONS, SCREEN BY SCREEN (GENERATED FROM THE LIVE INSTANCE)

How to read a screen: `#### Sxxx · <Action name> — <menu path>` then bullets: model, view switcher order (`view_mode` = order of the view-switcher buttons; the first is the default), fixed domain, context (default filters `search_default_*`, defaults `default_*`), the empty-state help text, then each view `Vnnn — TYPE view of model`. Inside a FORM view the tree is rendered exactly in layout order: HEADER (buttons + status bar), SHEET (button box, title, groups, notebook tabs…), CHATTER. Each field line = `field **name** "Label EN / AR" (type → relation) widget=… options=… placeholder=… required/readonly/hidden conditions … tooltip`. `hidden field x` = technical field loaded but not displayed (needed by conditions). `hidden when \`expr\`` uses the expression language of A-2. Buttons: `→ calls \`method\`` (server method, Part D) or `→ opens action \`id\`` (another screen/wizard). Labels are given as `English / العربية` — both must be implemented (i18n keys). Views marked "see Vnnn (rendered earlier)" are shared between screens/apps.

- Model: `sale.order` (Sales Order / أمر البيع); view switcher order: **list,form,calendar,graph,pivot,kanban,activity**

- Context: `{'create': False}`

- list options: title "Sales Orders / أوامر البيع"; multi-edit; row style-muted when `state == 'cancel'`

  - **"Create Invoices / إنشاء الفواتير"** → opens action `448` (Create invoice(s)) style=`btn-secondary`

  - hidden column `message_needaction` (loaded for conditions)

  - **date_order** "Order Date / تاريخ الطلب" (datetime) required readonly when `state in ['cancel', 'sale']` optional:show
  - **delivery_date** "Delivery Date / تاريخ التوصيل" (datetime) optional:hide style-danger when `(commitment_date and (expected_date < commitment_date or commitment_date < context_today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))) and state in ['draft', 'sent']` style-muted when `not commitment_date`
  - **commitment_date** "Promised Delivery / تاريخ التسليم الموعود" (datetime) readonly when always optional:hide
  - **partner_id** "Customer / العميل" (many2one → res.partner) required readonly when always
  - **user_id** "Salesperson / مندوب المبيعات" (many2one → res.users) widget=`many2one_avatar_user` optional:show

  - **amount_tax** "Taxes / الضرائب" (monetary) widget=`monetary` optional:hide footer sum "Tax Total / إجمالي الضريبة"
  - **amount_total** "Total / الإجمالي" (monetary) widget=`monetary` optional:show footer sum "Total Tax Included / الإجمالي شامل الضريبة" style-info when `invoice_status == 'to invoice'` style-bf when always
  - **tag_ids** "Tags / علامات التصنيف" (many2many → crm.tag) widget=`many2many_tags` options=`{'color_field': 'color', 'on_tag_click': 'edit_color'}` optional:hide

  - button **"Compute Depreciation / احتساب الإهلاك"** → calls `compute_depreciation_board` visible unless `state != 'draft'` hotkey alt+d
  - button **"Set to Running / التعيين كجارٍ"** → calls `set_to_running` visible unless `state != 'close'`
  - button **"Resume Depreciation / متابعة الإهلاك"** → calls `resume_after_pause` style=`oe_highlight` visible unless `state != 'paused'`
  - button **"Modify Depreciation / تعديل الإهلاكات"** → calls `action_asset_modify` style=`oe_highlight` visible unless `state != 'open'` hotkey alt+e
  - button **"Cancel Asset / إلغاء الأصل"** → calls `set_to_cancelled` visible unless `state != 'open'` hotkey alt+x
  - button **"Set to Draft / تعيين كمسودة"** → calls `set_to_draft` visible unless `depreciation_entries_count > 0 or state not in ['open', 'cancelled']`
  - field **state** "Status / الحالة" (selection) widget=`statusbar`
- SHEET (white card):
  - SMART BUTTONS (button box, top-right of sheet):
    - button **(icon button)** icon `fa-id-card-o` → calls `action_open_linked_assets` style=`oe_stat_button` visible unless `count_linked_asset == 0 or warning_count_assets`
    - button **(icon button)** icon `fa-id-card-o` → calls `action_open_linked_assets` style=`oe_stat_button text-danger` visible unless `count_linked_asset == 0 or not warning_count_assets`
    - button **(icon button)** icon `fa-bars` → calls `open_related_entries` style=`oe_stat_button` hotkey alt+r
    - button **(icon button)** icon `fa-bars` → calls `open_entries` style=`oe_stat_button` hotkey alt+shift+p
    - button **(icon button)** icon `fa-chevron-circle-up` → calls `open_increase` style=`oe_stat_button` visible unless `gross_increase_count == 0`
    - button **"Parent Asset / الأصل الرئيسي"** icon `fa-bars` → calls `open_parent_id` style=`oe_stat_button` visible unless `not parent_id`
    - button **(icon button)** icon `fa-bars` → calls `action_open_linked_loans` style=`oe_stat_button` visible unless `count_linked_loans == 0`
    - hidden field `vehicle_id` (technical, used in conditions)
    - button **"Vehicle / المركبة"** icon `fa-car` → calls `action_open_vehicle` style=`oe_stat_button` visible unless `not vehicle_id`

          - field **asset_group_id** "Asset Group / مجموعة الأصول" (many2one → account.asset.group)
          - field **vehicle_id** "Vehicle / المركبة" (many2one → fleet.vehicle) hidden when `not is_vehicle and not vehicle_id`
        - group **Current Values / القيم الحالية** name=current_values

#### S184 · Requests for Quotation — Purchase

- Model: `purchase.order` (Purchase Order / أمر شراء); view switcher order: **list,kanban,form,pivot,graph,calendar,activity**; URL path `/odoo/purchase`
- Context: `{'quotation_only': True}`
- Empty-state help: "No request for quotation found. Let's create one! Requests for quotation are documents that will be sent to your suppliers to request prices for different products you consider buying. Once an agreement has been found with the supplier, they will be confirmed and turned into purchase orders."

**V436 — LIST view of `purchase.order`** (odoo view id 2294)

- list options: title "Purchase Order / أمر شراء"; multi-edit; custom js_class=`purchase_dashboard_list`; row style-info when `state in ['draft', 'sent']`; row style-muted when `state == 'cancel'`

  - **"Cancel / إلغاء"** → calls `button_cancel` confirm: "Are you sure you want to cancel the selected RFQs/Orders? / هل أنت متأكد من أنك ترغب في إلغاء طلبات عروض الأسعار/الطلبات المحددة؟" hotkey alt+x

## PART F — SETTINGS PAGES

### SETTINGS PAGES (Configuration › Settings of every app; one page with a left sidebar listing the app sections)

The settings page is a single form (`res.config.settings`) with a left sidebar of app sections; clicking an app scrolls to its block. Each SETTING is a card with a checkbox/field, a label, and help text; some reveal extra fields when enabled. A sticky header shows **Save** / **Discard** buttons and a search box that filters settings.

## PART J — BUILD ORDER, QUALITY GATES AND ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST

### J-1. Build phases (do them in this order; each phase must pass its gate before the next)

1. **Foundation**: Amplify Gen 2 backend (auth, Aurora Postgres, storage, functions skeleton), Next.js app shell with i18n (EN/AR) + RTL build, design tokens (Part B) as CSS variables, Bootstrap 5 utilities, icon fonts, login page (B-10). Gate: login works, language switch mirrors the layout, Part B tokens verified in a Storybook page showing every component.
2. **Engine core**: registry types, expression evaluator + domain compiler (unit-tested against every expression string in Part E), ORM (create/write/unlink/search_read/read_group/name_search/onchange/default_get/copy/archive/sequences/mixins/access rules), menus & actions loader, URL router, control panel + search view + filters/group-by/favorites, list view, form view, kanban view, field widgets (the full list in A-4 §6), dialogs, chatter, activities, followers, attachments, import/export, command palette, systray menus, home menu, user menu, preferences. Gate: the Sales app (Part E APP 6) is fully usable end-to-end (create product, customer, quotation, send, confirm, invoice via wizard) with pixel-parity screenshots.
3. **Remaining generic views**: calendar, pivot, graph, gantt, activity, map, cohort, grid, hierarchy; settings page engine; PDF report engine + document layout; email (SES) + templates; scheduled jobs framework. Gate: Part E APPs 2, 3, 4, 11, 12, 15, 17 screens render from metadata without app-specific code except their `js_class` behaviours.
4. **Apps in this order** (each with its business methods from Part D, seed data from Part I, settings from Part F): Settings & Users & Companies → Discuss → Calendar → Appointments → To-do → Knowledge → Sales → Rental → Accounting (largest) → Purchase → Project → Planning → Helpdesk → Employees → Attendances → Fleet → Approvals → Sign → Surveys → Documents → Dashboards (spreadsheet renderer) → Apps. Gate per app: the e2e spec of every S-screen of the app passes (A-8), all buttons work, all filters/group-bys produce correct SQL, Arabic labels present, RTL screenshots parity.
5. **Cross-app flows (Part D)** integration tests: quote → order → invoice → payment → bank reconciliation → reports; PO → bill → payment; approval "Create RFQ's" → PO; sale of service → project/task/planning shifts; ticket → task; employee → attendance kiosk → overtime approval; sign request from employee/documents; documents mirroring; dashboards numbers equal to reports.
6. **Polish**: onboarding/empty states & sample data, keyboard shortcuts, tooltips, toasts, error dialogs, debug mode tools, PWA install, push notifications, performance (list of 10k rows paginates in <300 ms; kanban drag <50 ms), accessibility (focus rings, aria labels as in Odoo), mobile layouts.

### J-2. Definition of done (verify every item; the reviewer will compare against the live Odoo instance)

- [ ] Home menu shows the 22 apps in the right order with correct icons/captions (EN/AR) and the trial banner component (configurable).
- [ ] Every one of the 331 menu items in Part E exists at its place in the navbar and opens the listed screen with the listed default filters, view order and empty-state text.
- [ ] Every view definition (V001…V661) renders all listed columns/fields/buttons/tabs/widgets with the listed conditions; optional columns default show/hide states respected; footer sums present; decorations applied.
- [ ] Every form header button and smart button exists with its visibility condition and calls a working server method; every wizard (S-secondary screens) opens with the listed fields and footer buttons.
- [ ] Every search view field/filter/group-by/search panel item exists with the listed domain semantics; date filters produce Odoo's period options; favorites can be saved/shared/defaulted.
- [ ] Every SETTING in Part F exists with its label/help/dependent fields and actually changes behaviour.
- [ ] Every field in Part H exists in the database with the right type/relation/selection/required flags and EN/AR labels; selection values identical.
- [ ] All seed records of Part I exist after a fresh deploy.
- [ ] All custom screens of Part C behave as described (Discuss real-time chat & calls, Knowledge editor with the full powerbox, Dashboards with all widgets, Documents with viewer/actions/requests, Sign editor with drag-drop fields & signing flow & certificate, Attendance kiosk & systray, Accounting dashboard cards & all financial reports with their filters/columns/lines, Helpdesk overview, Approvals dashboard, Planning gantt actions, Surveys builder/results/live session, Appointments booking page, portals).
- [ ] Chatter, activities, followers, attachments, tracking, notifications, email sending/receiving, canned responses, mentions, emojis work on every model that has a chatter in Part E.
- [ ] Numbering, state machines, computed totals, taxes, currency rounding, dates/timezones, access rights and record rules behave as in Part D.
- [ ] PDF reports match Odoo's layouts; XLSX exports open in Excel.
- [ ] Arabic mode: every label translated (use the AR strings in this document; translate the few remaining English ones), full RTL mirroring, Arabic-Indic digits for dates, Latin digits for amounts, Saturday week start.
- [ ] Visual parity: side-by-side screenshots of each screen in EN and AR at 1280×609 differ by <0.5% pixels from the reference (allowing for fonts).
- [ ] No console errors; all mutations transactional; concurrent edits detected; pagination everywhere; loading states; no hard-coded data.

### J-3. How to consume this document with an AI coding agent

Work app by app. For each phase, load Parts A–D once, then only the relevant Part E section plus the Part F/H/I rows for the models involved. Never paraphrase view definitions — transcribe them into registry JSON exactly (or generate them from the companion `odoo_spec.json`). When a behaviour is not spelled out here, replicate Odoo 19 Enterprise's behaviour.
